mapper.select: SELECT id, sido, sigungu, nx, ny FROM region WHERE sido = #{sido} AND REPLACE(sigungu, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{sigungu}, ' ', ''), '%') LIMIT 1
SELECT id, sido, sigungu, nx, ny FROM region WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT sido FROM region WHERE sido IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sido ASC
SELECT DISTINCT sigungu FROM region WHERE sido = #{sido} AND sigungu IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sigungu ASC
SELECT id, sido, sigungu, nx, ny FROM region ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT trip_id AS tripId, name, image_url AS imageUrl, region_id AS regionId, content_id AS contentId, category, full_address AS fullAddress, lat, lon FROM trip WHERE region_id = #{regionId}
